g.text: Use cases sit in the middle. Everything that touches disk, the network or a model is an adapter behind a port.

text.tspan: Hono + OpenAPI: today (the plan's lesson and assessment),
calendar, corrections, events, disruptions, exams, todos,
AI jobs and review; courses, packs, scheme + import
preview + suggest-counts (starts the AI job), positions, plans
(+ lessons without a slot), placements (+ declared), check-in

g.text: Driven adapters, each behind a port

text.tspan: exams, todos, review AI item; loadPlanInputs,
one AI job at a time,

svg.text: Data that stays on the Mac
